lines.text: Lesson seventeen: support, resistance, breakout and fakeout.
lines.say: Lesson seventeen: support, resistance, breakout and fakeout.

lines.text: The price areas traders watch, and how to read them calmly.
lines.say: The price areas traders watch, and how to read them calmly.

lines.text: In lesson sixteen, you marked swing highs and swing lows on a chart.
lines.say: In lesson sixteen, you marked swing highs and swing lows on a chart.

lines.text: Look closely. Price keeps turning back near the same two areas.
lines.say: Look closely. Price keeps turning back near the same two areas.

lines.text: Why does that happen? And what if price finally pushes through?
lines.say: Why does that happen? And what if price finally pushes through?

lines.text: Support is a price area where falling price has stopped and turned up before.
lines.say: Support is a price area where falling price has stopped and turned up before.

lines.text: Think of a floor. Price drops, lands on it, and bounces.
lines.say: Think of a floor. Price drops, lands on it, and bounces.

lines.text: Here, price fell to about 59,850 three times. Each touch is called a test.
lines.say: Here, price fell to about fifty-nine thousand eight hundred fifty three times. Each touch is called a test.

lines.text: Buyers stepped in there before. That is all support tells you: what happened before.
lines.say: Buyers stepped in there before. That is all support tells you: what happened before.

lines.text: Resistance is the opposite: an area where rising price has stopped and turned down.
lines.say: Resistance is the opposite: an area where rising price has stopped and turned down.

lines.text: Like a ceiling. Price climbs, bumps into it, and falls back.
lines.say: Like a ceiling. Price climbs, bumps into it, and falls back.

lines.text: Here, rallies stalled near 60,350 twice. Sellers were waiting there before.
lines.say: Here, rallies stalled near sixty thousand three hundred fifty twice. Sellers were waiting there before.

lines.text: An important detail: support and resistance are zones, not exact lines.
lines.say: An important detail: support and resistance are zones, not exact lines.

lines.text: The three lows were 59,830, 59,860 and 59,880. Not one exact price.
lines.say: The three lows were fifty-nine thousand eight hundred thirty, fifty-nine thousand eight hundred sixty and fifty-nine thousand eight hundred eighty. Not one exact price.

lines.text: So we draw a band from 59,800 to 59,900. That zone is 100 USDT tall.
lines.say: So we draw a band from fifty-nine thousand eight hundred to fifty-nine thousand nine hundred. That zone is one hundred U-S-D-T tall.

lines.text: Price can poke into a zone, or a little through it, without anything changing.
lines.say: Price can poke into a zone, or a little through it, without anything changing.

lines.text: A breakout is when price closes beyond a zone and keeps going.
lines.say: A breakout is when price closes beyond a zone and keeps going.

lines.text: Our resistance zone runs from 60,300 to 60,400. Watch this candle.
lines.say: Our resistance zone runs from sixty thousand three hundred to sixty thousand four hundred. Watch this candle.

lines.text: It closes at 60,480: a full 80 USDT above the top of the zone.
lines.say: It closes at sixty thousand four hundred eighty: a full eighty U-S-D-T above the top of the zone.

lines.text: Then price comes back to the zone from above. That's a retest. Here, it holds.
lines.say: Then price comes back to the zone from above. That's a retest. Here, it holds.

lines.text: The old ceiling acted like a floor. This time.
lines.say: The old ceiling acted like a floor. This time.

lines.text: Now the same chart, with a different ending.
lines.say: Now the same chart, with a different ending.

lines.text: A fakeout, or false breakout, is when price pokes beyond a zone, then falls back inside.
lines.say: A fakeout, or false breakout, is when price pokes beyond a zone, then falls back inside.

lines.text: The wick reaches 60,460, but the candle closes at 60,350, back inside the zone.
lines.say: The wick reaches sixty thousand four hundred sixty, but the candle closes at sixty thousand three hundred fifty, back inside the zone.

lines.text: Then price drops toward 60,150. Same past chart, two different futures.
lines.say: Then price drops toward sixty thousand one hundred fifty. Same past chart, two different futures.

lines.text: So what counts as confirmation? Evidence that a breakout is holding.
lines.say: So what counts as confirmation? Evidence that a breakout is holding.

lines.text: One: a candle closes beyond the zone. A wick alone is not enough.
lines.say: One: a candle closes beyond the zone. A wick alone is not enough.

lines.text: Two: the next candles stay beyond it, too.
lines.say: Two: the next candles stay beyond it, too.

lines.text: Three: if price comes back for a retest, the zone holds.
lines.say: Three: if price comes back for a retest, the zone holds.

lines.text: Confirmation makes a breakout more believable. It never makes it certain.
lines.say: Confirmation makes a breakout more believable. It never makes it certain.

lines.text: A common mistake: drawing one exact line and expecting price to obey it.
lines.say: A common mistake: drawing one exact line and expecting price to obey it.

lines.text: Or jumping in the moment a wick crosses that line.
lines.say: Or jumping in the moment a wick crosses that line.

lines.text: The fix: draw zones, wait for candles to close, and treat every level as a maybe.
lines.say: The fix: draw zones, wait for candles to close, and treat every level as a maybe.

lines.text: And WAIT is always allowed. You never have to act on a level.
lines.say: And wait is always allowed. You never have to act on a level.

lines.text: Your turn. The resistance zone is 60,300 to 60,400.
lines.say: Your turn. The resistance zone is sixty thousand three hundred to sixty thousand four hundred.

lines.text: The last candle wicked to 60,450 but closed at 60,380. Is the breakout confirmed?
lines.say: The last candle wicked to sixty thousand four hundred fifty but closed at sixty thousand three hundred eighty. Is the breakout confirmed?

lines.text: Not yet. The close, 60,380, is still 20 USDT inside the zone.
lines.say: Not yet. The close, sixty thousand three hundred eighty, is still twenty U-S-D-T inside the zone.

lines.text: A sensible choice here is WAIT, and watch where the next candle closes.
lines.say: A sensible choice here is wait, and watch where the next candle closes.

lines.text: One more warning. Liquidity means how many orders are waiting near the price.
lines.say: One more warning. Liquidity means how many orders are waiting near the price.

lines.text: When liquidity is thin, only a few small orders are waiting.
lines.say: When liquidity is thin, only a few small orders are waiting.

lines.text: Then one larger order can jump price through a zone, and it snaps back moments later.
lines.say: Then one larger order can jump price through a zone, and it snaps back moments later.

lines.text: It looked like a breakout. It was just a thin market.
lines.say: It looked like a breakout. It was just a thin market.

lines.text: Before you use any of this, know the limits.
lines.say: Before you use any of this, know the limits.

lines.text: Lines come from past prices. They promise nothing about the future.
lines.say: Lines come from past prices. They promise nothing about the future.

lines.text: Fakeouts are common, thin markets can fake a breakout, and stops can slip.
lines.say: Fakeouts are common, thin markets can fake a breakout, and stops can slip.

lines.text: Losses are always possible. WAIT is a decision, not a failure.
lines.say: Losses are always possible. Wait is a decision, not a failure.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Support and resistance are zones where price turned before. Not walls.
lines.say: Support and resistance are zones where price turned before. Not walls.

lines.text: A breakout closes beyond a zone and holds. A fakeout falls back inside.
lines.say: A breakout closes beyond a zone and holds. A fakeout falls back inside.

lines.text: Confirmation is evidence, not certainty. WAIT is always allowed.
lines.say: Confirmation is evidence, not certainty. Wait is always allowed.

lines.text: Check yourself: a wick crosses resistance, but the candle closes inside. Breakout?
lines.say: Check yourself: a wick crosses resistance, but the candle closes inside. Breakout?

lines.text: Not confirmed. It could be a fakeout. Wait for a close beyond the zone.
lines.say: Not confirmed. It could be a fakeout. Wait for a close beyond the zone.

lines.text: Well done! Next up: volume, volatility and range. See you in lesson eighteen.
lines.say: Well done! Next up: volume, volatility and range. See you in lesson eighteen.
